title: Adjacent word-edge association after matching exact lengths and lines
statement: In paragraph text, conditional mutual information between the last EVA-basic glyph of a certain word and the first glyph of the next certain word exceeds the same statistic after shuffling words within their original line and exact glyph length. The one-sided comparison uses 199 permutations and p at most 0.01 on each scored transliteration.
source: Pavlenko77's preregistered public pilot P-L2-020 (https://github.com/Ayan-Bandyopadhyay/voynich-swarm/pull/670) and the merged scorer primitive (https://github.com/Ayan-Bandyopadhyay/voynich-swarm/pull/673).
